Why is ball 100 guaranteed (100% probability / prob = 1.0) to be ejected?

Let's trace what happens when ball 100 reaches the platform:
- Ball 100 is the last ball (ball #100).
- When ball 100 enters the platform, there are no more balls behind it on the ramp.
- Whenever ball 100 reaches position 1 (the first position), can it ever be released (lost)?
  - A ball in position 1 is ONLY released/lost if piston 2 (position 2) or piston 3 (position 3) fires.
  - But when ball 100 is the LAST ball remaining in the entire system (or at the end of the platform), if it's in position 1 and positions 2 & 3 are empty, only piston 1 can fire (which ejects ball 100!).
  - If ball 100 is in position 2 or 3, firing piston 2 or 3 directly ejects ball 100!
  - If piston 1 fires when ball 100 is in position 2 or 3, ball 100 advances towards position 1.
  - Therefore, ball 100 CAN NEVER BE RELEASED! It is impossible for ball 100 to roll away without being ejected by a piston. Thus, ball 100 is ejected with 100% certainty (probability 1).

Therefore, ball 100 maximizes your odds of winning the big prize (with a win probability of 100%).
